description: This source file defines structures and an actor related to executing hooks within the SwabbleCore project. It includes the definition of a simple data structure for hook jobs and an actor that manages the execution of hook commands with configuration, concurrency, and timeout handling.

classes.name: HookJob
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a hook job with text and timestamp, conforming to Sendable.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands based on configuration, managing reuse, cooldowns, and termination timing.

methods.name: HookJob.init
methods.description: Initializer for HookJob, takes text and timestamp.

methods.name: HookExecutor.init
methods.description: Initializer for HookExecutor, sets up configuration and hostname.

methods.name: HookExecutor.shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the hook should run based on cooldown configuration.

methods.name: HookExecutor.run
methods.description: Executes the hook command asynchronously, with environment setup, timeout, and process management.
